build_note: 23andMe genotypes are plus-strand GRCh37. SNPedia often reports minus-strand alleles — compare genotype_sorted and complement_sorted before interpreting literature.

evidence_levels.clinical: Used in clinical guidelines or well-established Mendelian/PGx practice (ClinVar expert panel, CPIC). Still not a diagnosis from array data alone.
evidence_levels.replicated_gwas: Replicated common-variant association. Effect sizes are usually small; environment dominates.
evidence_levels.exploratory: Popular in consumer reports or candidate-gene papers. Treat as a conversation starter, not a trait score.

markers.name: APOE epsilon site 1 (Cys112Arg)
markers.topic: APOE e2/e3/e4 haplotype with rs7412. e4 is associated with Alzheimer disease and CAD risk.
markers.caveat: Must be read with rs7412. Array calls are not a clinical APOE test.

markers.name: APOE epsilon site 2 (Arg158Cys)
markers.topic: APOE e2/e3/e4 haplotype with rs429358.
markers.caveat: e2/e2 is associated with type III hyperlipoproteinemia in some people.

markers.name: 9p21 CAD locus
markers.topic: Common coronary artery disease susceptibility near 9p21.
markers.caveat: Modest effect; lifestyle and lipids matter more.

markers.name: 9p21 CAD proxy
markers.topic: Alternate 9p21 CAD marker, often in LD with rs10757278.
markers.caveat: Not independent of rs10757278.

markers.name: Lp(a) missense marker
markers.topic: Associated with elevated lipoprotein(a) and CAD / aortic stenosis risk.
markers.caveat: A plasma Lp(a) lab is the actual clinical test.

markers.name: Lp(a) intron marker
markers.topic: Second common LPA CAD / Lp(a) marker.
markers.caveat: Does not replace an Lp(a) blood test.

markers.name: Factor V Leiden (R506Q)
markers.topic: Inherited thrombophilia; venous clot risk, especially with estrogen, surgery, pregnancy.
markers.caveat: Confirm before any clinical decision. Homozygotes have much higher risk.

markers.name: Prothrombin G20210A
markers.topic: Inherited thrombophilia; higher prothrombin and VTE risk.
markers.caveat: Confirm clinically. Risk interacts with other factors.

markers.name: 4q25 atrial fibrillation locus
markers.topic: Common AF susceptibility near PITX2.
markers.caveat: Predisposition only; not an AF diagnosis.

markers.name: FOXO3 longevity marker
markers.topic: Associated with longevity in several populations.
markers.caveat: Small effect; not a lifespan prediction.

markers.name: HFE C282Y
markers.topic: Primary hereditary hemochromatosis variant.
markers.caveat: Incomplete penetrance. Ferritin/transferrin saturation are the clinical tests. Compound heterozygosity with H63D also matters.

markers.name: HFE H63D
markers.topic: Secondary hemochromatosis variant; lower penetrance than C282Y.
markers.caveat: Most meaningful as C282Y/H63D compound heterozygote.

markers.name: HFE S65C
markers.topic: Minor HFE variant.
markers.caveat: Usually mild; interpret with C282Y.

markers.name: MTHFR C677T
markers.topic: Reduced MTHFR activity; associated with higher homocysteine.
markers.caveat: ACMG does not recommend MTHFR testing for most clinical uses. Do not over-interpret.

markers.name: MTHFR A1298C
markers.topic: Second MTHFR coding variant; milder than C677T.
markers.caveat: Clinical meaning is limited, especially in isolation.

markers.name: MTR A2756G
markers.topic: Methionine synthase variant in the B12/folate cycle.
markers.caveat: Candidate-gene evidence; not a B12 diagnosis.

markers.name: MTRR A66G
markers.topic: Methionine synthase reductase variant.
markers.caveat: Exploratory nutrigenetic marker.

markers.name: FUT2 secretor status
markers.topic: Secretor status; associated with B12 levels and microbiome patterns.
markers.caveat: Does not diagnose B12 deficiency.

markers.name: CBS C699T
markers.topic: Transsulfuration / homocysteine pathway marker.
markers.caveat: Popular in consumer methylation reports; weak clinical utility.

markers.name: Lactase persistence (-13910 C>T)
markers.topic: European lactase-persistence allele. Plus-strand T is the persistence allele.
markers.caveat: Other persistence alleles exist in African/Middle Eastern populations. Symptoms beat the SNP.

markers.name: Lactase persistence proxy
markers.topic: Often in LD with rs4988235 in Europeans.
markers.caveat: Not independent in European ancestry.

markers.name: CYP1A2*1F caffeine metabolism
markers.topic: Caffeine clearance rate; slow metabolizers may have higher CV risk with heavy coffee in some studies.
markers.caveat: Smoking induces CYP1A2. Not a hard coffee ban.

markers.name: Coffee-consumption GWAS marker
markers.topic: Associated with habitual coffee intake.
markers.caveat: Tiny behavioral effect.

markers.name: Adenosine A2A caffeine anxiety
markers.topic: Candidate marker for caffeine-induced anxiety / sleep disruption.
markers.caveat: Mixed replication.

markers.name: ALDH2*2 alcohol flush
markers.topic: Acetaldehyde buildup, flushing, and higher esophageal cancer risk with drinking. Common in East Asian ancestry.
markers.caveat: Often absent on some chips in European-heavy arrays; check not_on_chip.

markers.name: ADH1B*2 fast alcohol oxidation
markers.topic: Faster ethanol to acetaldehyde; associated with lower heavy-drinking tendency.
markers.caveat: Interacts with ALDH2.

markers.name: FADS1 omega-3 conversion
markers.topic: Affects conversion of plant ALA to EPA/DHA.
markers.caveat: Diet still dominates circulating omega-3.

markers.name: PTC bitter taste (PAV/AVI)
markers.topic: Bitter-taste sensitivity to PTC/PROP and some vegetables.
markers.caveat: Trait, not a diet prescription. Other TAS2R38 SNPs complete the haplotype.

markers.name: TAS2R38 haplotype SNP
markers.topic: Completes the common TAS2R38 taster haplotype with rs713598 and rs1726866.
markers.caveat: Read as a haplotype, not a single SNP.

markers.name: TAS2R38 haplotype SNP
markers.topic: Third common TAS2R38 haplotype marker.
markers.caveat: Read with rs713598 and rs10246939.

markers.name: TCF7L2 type 2 diabetes locus
markers.topic: Strongest common T2D SNP in many European GWAS.
markers.caveat: Still a small absolute risk shift versus BMI, age, and lifestyle.

markers.name: FTO BMI/obesity locus
markers.topic: Common BMI / obesity association; sometimes linked to appetite.
markers.caveat: Not destiny. Effect is modest.

markers.name: FTO functional obesity SNP
markers.topic: Often the better functional candidate at FTO than rs9939609.
markers.caveat: In LD with rs9939609 in Europeans.

markers.name: MC4R BMI locus
markers.topic: Common BMI association near MC4R.
markers.caveat: Not a monogenic MC4R deficiency test.

markers.name: PNPLA3 I148M fatty liver
markers.topic: Strong common NAFLD / hepatic fat marker.
markers.caveat: Alcohol, weight, and metabolic syndrome dominate clinical risk.

markers.name: TM6SF2 E167K fatty liver
markers.topic: NAFLD / liver-fat association.
markers.caveat: Common-variant predisposition only.

markers.name: CYP2C19*2 loss-of-function
markers.topic: Clopidogrel, some SSRIs, PPIs. Poor/intermediate metabolizer allele.
markers.caveat: Star-allele calling from a few SNPs is incomplete. CYP2D6 is especially poorly covered on arrays.

markers.name: CYP2C19*3 loss-of-function
markers.topic: Additional CYP2C19 LOF allele, more common in East Asian ancestry.
markers.caveat: May be rare/absent depending on ancestry and chip.

markers.name: CYP2C19*17 gain-of-function
markers.topic: Rapid/ultrarapid CYP2C19 allele.
markers.caveat: Phenotype depends on the full diplotype.

markers.name: CYP2C9*2
markers.topic: Reduced-function allele; warfarin, NSAIDs, phenytoin.
markers.caveat: Warfarin also depends on VKORC1 and clinical factors.

markers.name: CYP2C9*3
markers.topic: Stronger reduced-function CYP2C9 allele.
markers.caveat: Do not change prescriptions from this file.

markers.name: VKORC1 warfarin sensitivity
markers.topic: Major warfarin dose/sensitivity marker.
markers.caveat: Clinical dosing algorithms use more than this SNP.

markers.name: CYP4F2*3 (V433M)
markers.topic: Modest increase in warfarin dose requirement.
markers.caveat: Secondary to CYP2C9 + VKORC1.

markers.name: SLCO1B1*5 statin myopathy
markers.topic: Simvastatin myopathy risk; also relevant to some other statins.
markers.caveat: CPIC has specific drug/dose guidance. Not a statin ban.

markers.name: ABCG2 Q141K
markers.topic: Rosuvastatin exposure / transporter variant.
markers.caveat: Complement SLCO1B1 rather than replacing it.

markers.name: DPYD*2A
markers.topic: Severe fluoropyrimidine (5-FU, capecitabine) toxicity allele.
markers.caveat: Rare. If present, this is one of the few truly actionable PGx flags — still confirm clinically.

markers.name: DPYD*13
markers.topic: Fluoropyrimidine toxicity allele.
markers.caveat: Rare; array false positives possible.

markers.name: DPYD c.2846A>T
markers.topic: Decreased DPD function / fluoropyrimidine toxicity.
markers.caveat: Confirm before oncology decisions.

markers.name: DPYD HapB3 tag
markers.topic: Tag for DPYD HapB3 decreased-function haplotype.
markers.caveat: Tag SNP, not the causal intron variant.

markers.name: TPMT*3C
markers.topic: Thiopurine (azathioprine, 6-MP) myelosuppression risk.
markers.caveat: Other TPMT and NUDT15 alleles also matter. Clinical PGx testing is broader.

markers.name: TPMT*3B
markers.topic: Together with *3C defines TPMT*3A in cis.
markers.caveat: Phase is unknown from unphased array data.

markers.name: CYP3A5*3
markers.topic: Non-expressor allele; tacrolimus dosing differs for expressors.
markers.caveat: *3/*3 is common in European ancestry (non-expressor).

markers.name: CYP2D6*4 splice variant
markers.topic: Common European loss-of-function CYP2D6 allele (many antidepressants, codeine, tamoxifen).
markers.caveat: CYP2D6 needs CNV + many SNPs. Array data is incomplete. Do not call a metabolizer phenotype from this SNP alone.

markers.name: CYP2D6*10-related
markers.topic: Decreased-function CYP2D6 marker, more common in East Asian ancestry.
markers.caveat: Incomplete star calling on arrays.

markers.name: COMT Val158Met
markers.topic: Prefrontal dopamine clearance. Popular 'warrior/worrier' framing (Val/Val=GG faster clearance; Met/Met=AA slower).
markers.caveat: Effect on personality is small and context-dependent. Not a diagnosis of anxiety or resilience.

markers.name: BDNF Val66Met
markers.topic: Activity-dependent BDNF secretion; studied for memory, mood, exercise response.
markers.caveat: Candidate-gene findings often fail GWAS. Plus-strand Met is A/T depending on source — check strand.

markers.name: OXTR rs53576
markers.topic: Oxytocin receptor SNP studied for empathy, social sensitivity, and attachment-style papers.
markers.caveat: Replication is inconsistent. Do not treat as a personality test.

markers.name: OXTR rs2254298
markers.topic: Second commonly cited OXTR social-behavior SNP.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: DRD2/ANKK1 Taq1A
markers.topic: A1 allele associated with lower striatal D2 density; reward/addiction candidate literature.
markers.caveat: The SNP is in ANKK1, not DRD2 coding sequence. Small, disputed effects.

markers.name: DRD2 C957T
markers.topic: Dopamine D2 receptor synonymous variant; working-memory / reward papers.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: DRD4 promoter -521 C/T
markers.topic: Dopamine D4 promoter SNP; novelty-seeking literature is mixed.
markers.caveat: The famous DRD4 48bp VNTR is not this SNP and is usually not on 23andMe.

markers.name: HTR1A C-1019G
markers.topic: Serotonin 1A receptor promoter; depression/anxiety candidate studies.
markers.caveat: Not a clinical psychogenetics test.

markers.name: HTR2A T102C
markers.topic: Serotonin 2A receptor; studied for antipsychotic response and traits.
markers.caveat: In LD with rs6311. Weak for personality.

markers.name: HTR2A promoter G-1438A
markers.topic: HTR2A promoter variant.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: CACNA1C bipolar/mood GWAS SNP
markers.topic: Replicated association with bipolar disorder and broader mood/psychopathology in GWAS.
markers.caveat: Odds ratios are small. Not a personality or bipolar diagnosis.

markers.name: FKBP5 stress-response SNP
markers.topic: HPA-axis / PTSD / depression candidate gene, often with childhood-stress interaction papers.
markers.caveat: Gene-environment claims are controversial and often overfit.

markers.name: FKBP5 3' UTR SNP
markers.topic: Often analyzed with rs1360780 as an FKBP5 haplotype.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: TPH2 promoter G-703T
markers.topic: Tryptophan hydroxylase 2; serotonin synthesis candidate.
markers.caveat: Candidate-gene era; weak GWAS support.

markers.name: OPRM1 A118G (N40D)
markers.topic: Mu-opioid receptor; studied for pain, alcohol, and opioid response.
markers.caveat: CPIC/PharmGKB evidence for many drug uses is limited. Not a personality type.

markers.name: MAOA T941G / EcoRV
markers.topic: X-linked MAOA coding SNP sometimes used as a proxy in consumer reports.
markers.caveat: The famous MAOA-uVNTR ('warrior gene') is not this SNP and is usually not on 23andMe. Hemizygous in males.

markers.name: 5-HTTLPR-adjacent SNP
markers.topic: Near the serotonin transporter. Sometimes used to approximate 5-HTTLPR.
markers.caveat: 5-HTTLPR itself is an indel/VNTR, not reliably assayed on SNP chips.

markers.name: DBH C-1021T
markers.topic: Dopamine beta-hydroxylase promoter; attention/impulsivity candidate studies.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: CLOCK 3111 T/C
markers.topic: Circadian clock gene; eveningness / sleep-timing candidate papers.
markers.caveat: Chronotype is highly polygenic; this SNP is not a chronotype score.

markers.name: NPSR1 Asn107Ile
markers.topic: Neuropeptide S receptor; panic/anxiety candidate literature.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: CHRNA5 D398N nicotine dependence
markers.topic: Strongest common smoking-heaviness / nicotine-dependence SNP.
markers.caveat: Among smokers. Does not make someone a smoker.

markers.name: CHRNA3 smoking-quantity marker
markers.topic: In LD with rs16969968; smoking heaviness / lung-cancer risk via smoking.
markers.caveat: Proxy for the CHRNA5-A3-B4 cluster.

markers.name: ACTN3 R577X
markers.topic: Fast-twitch muscle protein. XX (stop/stop) is common in endurance-leaning profiles.
markers.caveat: Does not determine athletic ability. Training dominates.

markers.name: PPARA intron marker
markers.topic: Power vs endurance candidate marker.
markers.caveat: Sports-genetics marketing often oversells this.

markers.name: PGC-1alpha Gly482Ser
markers.topic: Mitochondrial biogenesis / VO2 trainability candidate.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: COL5A1 BstUI tendon marker
markers.topic: Tendon stiffness / soft-tissue injury candidate.
markers.caveat: Not an injury prediction.

markers.name: IL6 -174 G/C
markers.topic: IL-6 promoter; inflammation / recovery candidate.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: CFH Y402H AMD
markers.topic: Major common age-related macular degeneration risk SNP.
markers.caveat: Age, smoking, and exam findings matter more than this SNP alone.

markers.name: ARMS2 A69S AMD
markers.topic: Second major common AMD SNP; smoking amplifies risk.
markers.caveat: Predisposition, not a diagnosis.

markers.name: C3 R102G AMD
markers.topic: Complement C3 AMD marker.
markers.caveat: Smaller than CFH/ARMS2.

markers.name: Eye color (blue/brown)
markers.topic: Major European eye-color SNP.
markers.caveat: Trait, not health. Included because people ask.

markers.name: Pigmentation marker
markers.topic: Skin/hair pigmentation; also a health-relevant UV-sensitivity context.
markers.caveat: Ancestry-correlated. Not a melanoma test.

markers.name: Celiac HLA-DQ2.5 tag
markers.topic: Tag for HLA-DQ2.5, the main celiac-associated haplotype.
markers.caveat: A tag is not high-resolution HLA typing. Absence of tags lowers but does not perfectly exclude celiac genetic risk.

markers.name: Celiac HLA-DQ8 tag
markers.topic: Tag for HLA-DQ8 celiac risk haplotype.
markers.caveat: Tag SNP, not formal HLA typing.

markers.name: PTPN22 R620W autoimmunity
markers.topic: Shared autoimmune susceptibility (RA, T1D, others).
markers.caveat: Not disease-specific.

markers.name: Vitamin D synthesis GWAS SNP
markers.topic: Associated with circulating 25(OH)D.
markers.caveat: A blood test beats this SNP.

markers.name: CYP2R1 25-hydroxylase marker
markers.topic: Vitamin D activation / 25(OH)D levels.
markers.caveat: Lab value is the clinical measure.

markers.name: Vitamin D binding protein
markers.topic: Strong common 25(OH)D association.
markers.caveat: May affect measured 25(OH)D more than true deficiency biology.

markers.name: VDR FokI
markers.topic: Vitamin D receptor start-codon variant.
markers.caveat: Often mislabeled as TaqI. TaqI is rs731236.

markers.name: VDR TaqI
markers.topic: Common VDR synonymous variant.
markers.caveat: Consumer reports mix up FokI/TaqI/BsmI.

markers.name: DAO Thr16Met
markers.topic: Histamine-degrading DAO coding variant.
markers.caveat: Does not diagnose histamine intolerance.

markers.name: HNMT Thr105Ile
markers.topic: Intracellular histamine methylation.
markers.caveat: Exploratory.

markers.name: IFNL3 / IL28B hepatitis C response
markers.topic: Historically predicted interferon response in HCV; also used as an immune marker.
markers.caveat: Less relevant in the DAA era for HCV treatment choice.

markers.name: Sickle cell (Glu6Val)
markers.topic: Sickle hemoglobin. Heterozygotes have sickle-cell trait.
markers.caveat: May be a no-call or absent on some chips. Confirm any positive clinically.
